hook: Who was waiting by the bus shelter?
excerpt: She was halfway to the corner when something made her look back across the road, at the bus shelter where the young woman had been.

excerpt.text: There was no one there. Only the timetable in its scratched frame, and a crisp packet going round and round in the wind.

excerpt: Lorna stood at her kitchen window with the teabag in her hand and tried to remember whether there had been anyone on that corner.

excerpt.text: She thought there had been. She thought there had been someone in a doorway.

caption:
A different woman meets the girl every day. None of them ever looks at the school.
